adoption_state.note: The adopted_construct_set is empty because the S02 admission checkpoint records not-adopted. Every clause of this contract is conditional on a future adopted_construct_set that does not exist today: with an empty set the emission rule mints zero candidates, every outcome is Unknown and Conflict is unreachable. A specification table is not an adoption.

construct_dictionary.note: The eight families are not redeclared here: this contract references the S01 register for their identity, their fail-closed boundaries and their vocabulary status. No family is promoted: promoted_statuses is empty and every status stays exactly what the S01 register records.

candidate_envelope.envelope_role: design-only shape of an emission decision; no record is committed and no record may be committed while the adopted_construct_set is empty

verdict.note: Only the candidate_emitted verdict corresponds to a minted candidate record. Unknown and Conflict are distinct non-emission outcomes: they must never be materialized as candidates and must never be read as one another.

non_claims: The envelope is a declared shape, not a runtime object, and minted_field_count is zero.
A source anchor must name a repository-relative tracked path and a sha256, or the explicit unresolved marker; an anchor without either is not an anchor.
An envelope without an adopted_construct_ref is not a candidate.
An evidence_class outside the closed dictionary is not admissible.

outcomes.predicate: family_id is one of the closed eight families, family_id is in the adopted_construct_set, at least one proven source span establishes the family and the anchors agree
no proven source span establishes the family, or no adopted construct exists; absence of a proven source span is never falsity
at least two anchors of an adopted construct disagree; a Conflict is never a majority pick and never a silent preference

outcome_dictionary.rejected_single_outcome: There is no collapse outcome: Unknown and Conflict are separate outcomes with separate codes and separate predicates.

emission_rule.note: The emission rule is conditional on the adopted_construct_set. While that set is empty, no candidate can be emitted and Conflict is unreachable, so every outcome is Unknown by construction rather than by omission.

boundaries.note: Classification is not composition: no composed rule, no facet default and no applicability evaluation is performed or promised. The six section 3 terms stay deferred-undefined, F13 is a separate decision with its own adoption, and Applicable, RuVector and TEI are not claimed.

consumes.role: admission source: records not-adopted with owner_admission_ref none, so this contract is conditional and the committed adopted_construct_set must stay empty
start gate: admission_absent, runtime_implementation_permitted false and adopted_construct_set empty bound this contract to the no-start contour
closed eight-family dictionary, per-family fail-closed boundaries, vocabulary statuses and the closed evidence-class dictionary
variant C abstention_first_candidates_only: representation shape, consequences_for_S03, collapse risks and the empty required_new_adr_terms list

non_claims: This contract is design-only: it mints no candidate, no normative IR, no rule graph and no crate surface, and it commits no record.
It is not an adoption of normative semantics: adopted_construct_set is empty, adopted_variant is null and is_adoption is false; a specification table is not an adoption.
Unknown is not Conflict and neither is a negative finding: absence of a proven source span is never falsity, and a Conflict is never a majority pick.
Classification is not composition: no composed rule, no facet default and no applicability evaluation is performed or promised.
NormRule, Condition, LegalEffect, Exception, Defeater and ApplicabilitySelector stay deferred-undefined; section 3 is not edited and no term is promoted.
F13 is a separate decision with its own adoption and is never derived from the bounded IR.
Out-of-scope surfaces stay untouched: Applicable, RuVector, TEI and the F13 operation grammar are not claimed.
No candidate can be emitted while the adopted_construct_set is empty, and Conflict is unreachable in that state.
revision_policy: Re-derive before use: re-hash every consumed path, re-read the S01 register family statuses and the closed evidence-class dictionary, and re-bind the adopted_construct_set from the live S02 checkpoint before showing this contract; no timestamp and no aggregate engine hash are stored here.
